name: Psychology as a Social Science
notes: RETIRED MINOR - only available to students who declared it before Fall 2023. Every other student takes the single Psychology minor introduced that term (minor-psyc), which the department encourages even for earlier declarers. It is encoded here because the University's official program list still carries it and students who declared in time may still finish it. DO NOT DECLARE THIS AS A NEW STUDENT.
Five courses. This minor satisfies a social science divisional requirement.
Students may not receive credit for both PSYC 170 and PSYC 171.

PSYC 101 may be replaced by its equivalent, including a grade of B- or higher in PSYC 101A, a 4 or 5 on the AP psychology test, or a 6 or better on the higher-level IB psychology exam. PSYC 101A is not in the 2025-26 catalog.
Up to two transferred psychology courses, in addition to Introduction to Psychology, may be used in the minor plan.

SOCIAL VS NATURAL SCIENCE: social-science psychology courses are PSYC courses NOT cross-listed with BCSC; natural-science ones ARE cross-listed with BCSC. The exceptions run both ways - PSYC 170/BCSC 170, PSYC 210/BCSC 185 and PSYC 248/BCSC 278 count as social science and not as natural science. The catalog does not record cross-listing, so the planner cannot enforce the split.

requirementGroups.label: Introduction to Psychology
requirementGroups.sourceQuote: PSYC 101: Introduction to Psychology or the equivalent (which may include a grade of B- or higher in PSYC 101A)

requirementGroups.label: Two social-science psychology core courses
requirementGroups.sourceQuote: Two of following social science psychology core courses: PSYC 161: Social Psychology and Individual Differences; PSYC 171: Social and Emotional Development or PSYC 170: Child Development; PSYC 181: Theories of Personality and Psychotherapy
requirementGroups.note: PSYC 170 and PSYC 171 are alternatives to each other - students may not receive credit for both, so they count as ONE of the three core options.

requirementGroups.label: Two further social-science psychology courses
requirementGroups.sourceQuote: Two additional social science psychology courses (courses not cross-listed as BCSC). Note: PSYC 210/BCSC 185 and PSYC 248/BCSC 278 do count as social science courses.
